verdict.rationale: Several documented one-liners install the collection: `claude plugin install mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official`, which an ADR names as the documented route via Claude Code's official marketplace, and `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills`. Codex and Copilot use marketplace add plus install commands. Docs say to install, then type a slash command, and the plugin variants update themselves at startup, which implies they are active in later sessions. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that skills are active in the next session without further steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the install works.
